entries.text: You’re [VAR 0x0100(0000)] or whatever, right?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_sister_01

entries.text: Let me guess—you want to pair up with one of us\npoor, lonely Blueberry students?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_sister_02

entries.text: Gosh, it’s so sweet of you to go out of your way\nlike that. What would we ever do without you?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_sister_03

entries.text: Wait, but you’re the one who came to talk to us.\nWhat are you, some kinda weirdo?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_sister_04

entries.text: Oh yeah. So my little brother here has been\nall googly-eyed over you since yesterday.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_sister_05

entries.text: He wouldn’t stop talking about you—even at\nhome. I seriously couldn’t get him to shut up.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_sister_06

entries.text: S-Sis! What’re you tellin’ h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]imer that for, dummy![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_brother_01

entries.text: HEY! Watch who you call “dummy,” if you know\nwhat’s good for you![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_sister_07

entries.text: Look at him, being all shy...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_sister_08

entries.text: See, my brother’s no good at talking to people.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_sister_09

entries.text: He’d probably never work up the nerve to ask\nyou himself, but he’d really like a battle with you.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_sister_10

entries.text: C’mon, please? Just have a battle with my\nbrother, would you?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_sister_11

entries.text: Huh? What’s that? I couldn’t hear you.\c\nWhen you’ve cleared your throat of whatever\nthat was and are ready to say yes, lemme know.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_sister_12

entries.text: Well, what do you know—turns out you’re sorta\nnice. This’ll make my brother real happy.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_sister_13

entries.text: Chin up, Kiki!\c\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)] says [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0100)]she’ll battle you![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_sister_14

entries.text: W-wowzers, really?! You don’t mind?![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_brother_04

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0201)]HShe doesn’t mind a bit.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_sister_15

entries.text: Get to your positions, you two. Everybody else,\nclear out. Make some space![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_sister_16

entries.text: I-I got this![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_brother_05

entries.text: Good show!
entries.label: sdc01_0100_student1_01

entries.text: Nicely done, kids! Nothing like a friendly battle\nto get to know someone![VAR 0x0114(0042)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_bbteacher_01

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]W-wowzers! You sure are strong,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_brother_06

entries.text: That was some kinda battle!\c\nI bet you’re something else when you’re not\nholdin’ back, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_brother_07

entries.text: You really aren’t half bad. Kiki’s nearly as strong\nas I am, you know.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_sister_17

entries.text: I dunno about that...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_brother_08

entries.text: This orienteering thing... We’re supposed to\ngroup up in pairs, right?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_sister_18

entries.text: You should go ahead and pair up with Kiki, then.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_sister_19

entries.text: What?! No, Sis, don’t—![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_brother_09

entries.text: Don’t what? It’s not like we can pair up. Or were\nyou hoping to partner with some other rando\r\noutsider instead of [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_sister_20

entries.text: Well...no, but... Aw man...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_brother_10

entries.text: Don’t worry. He’s just being shy.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_sister_21

entries.text: I’ll go find some chump to pair up with too.\nWatch out for my little bro, you.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_sister_22

entries.text: Looks like you’ve all paired up![VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_caretaker_01

entries.text: Let’s go ahead and mark where you’ll be going\non those Rotom Phones of yours.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_caretaker_02

entries.text: Now then, off you go to do some exploring![VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_caretaker_03

entries.text: Oh, and if you find yourself in need of any\nPotions or Poké Balls or the like...[VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_caretaker_05

entries.text: head on over thataway and stop by Peachy’s!\nThey’d be happy to set you to rights.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_caretaker_06

entries.text:
So it looks like...we should probably start with
the signboard at...[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Loyalty Plaza[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]...\c
That’s out past the apple orchards on the west
side of the village...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_brother_12

entries.text: It’s close by. And I figure it might, um, make\nsense to...y’know...visit them all in order...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_brother_13

entries.text: I’ll probably just get in your way if I stick too\nclose, so I’ll just...follow you from a safe distance![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_brother_14

entries.text: Welcome to Kitakami Hall! We’re glad to have\nyou here. Relax and enjoy yourself![VAR 0x0114(0045)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_caretaker_04

entries.text: Nice to meet you, Carmine!
entries.label: sdc01_0100_student1_02

entries.text: I felt bad leaving this kid on his own, so I guess\nI’ll partner up with him.
entries.label: sdc01_0100_student2_01

entries.text: I can’t wait to see what Pokémon we discover\nwhile looking for those signboards!
entries.label: sdc01_0100_student3_01

entries.text: Let’s do this, outsider—I mean, uh, totally\nordinary guy![VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_sister_23

entries.text:
Finally time to kick off this school trip in earnest.
Get out there and do some orienteering!\c
You’ve come all the way here to Kitakami, so you
should see everything it’s got to offer![VAR 0x0114(0042)]
entries.label: sdc01_0100_bbteacher_02
